biggest_catch: Both bonuses require credit approval for a new JCPenney Credit Card or Mastercard: denied applications get nothing. Applying is a hard inquiry, and the 33.24% variable purchase APR means carrying a balance on the $35-$499.99 or $500+ qualifying purchase would cost far more than the $35/$125 savings.
catches: Savings on planned spending, not income: the $10 CashPass certificate and the $35/$125 coupons reduce JCPenney purchases — never buy extra just to chase them.
Both offers require credit approval for a NEW JCPenney Credit Card/Mastercard account; denied applicants get nothing.
Never spend extra to chase the tiers: the $35/$125 coupon only pays off on purchases you already planned (coupon cannot be used with other coupons and has no cash value).
The official offer page does not state the card's annual fee — check the credit terms disclosures before applying; the variable purchase APR is 33.24% (per the official page), so carry no balance.
Full card application = hard inquiry on your credit report.
First-purchase coupon valid only from approval through 11/30/2026; one use per coupon; excludes gift cards, services, prior purchases, and payment on account.
